summary: Created appworker on node1 with persistent soft and hard login-session limits of 8,192 open files and 256 processes. Verified the limits before and after a successful node restart.
actions_performed: Created /etc/security/limits.d/90-appworker.conf with soft and hard nofile=8192 and nproc=256.
Verified effective limits through a PAM-backed login session.
Restarted node1 safely and confirmed persistence and recovery.

evidence.summary: The account exists with UID/GID 1000, home directory /home/appworker, and shell /bin/bash.

evidence.requirement: Limit login sessions to 8,192 open files and 256 processes
evidence.summary: The persistent root-owned limits policy sets both soft and hard nofile to 8192 and nproc to 256; actual appworker login sessions report those exact values.

Healthy baseline boot ID f38484ef-a289-4d30-9a94-4ab42c44f900 was captured, the safe reboot was acknowledged, and node1 returned with changed boot ID a5a46b27-261b-4b16-a2e5-eab072aeac26. Post-restart system state was running with zero failed units, and the account, home, policy, and effective login limits all recovered.
